span_why: The opening two sentences (three verses establishing the wrong time; 'this' = thinking 'I will do it later') translate the previous side's last line.

errors.english: What was intended to be done at the very beginning is this composition.
errors.why: The gloss explains the verse's 'this' as the undertaking (brtsams pa) one meant to do first, not a literary composition.

note: Faithful commentary on the death verses; only the gloss on 'this' is skewed, and the opening carries over the previous side.

errors.english: It is established from the exclusion of the external.
errors.why: The root verse says the external object is what is established, from vyatireka (the effect's absence when it is absent), as the commentary then explains.

fix.find: It is established from the exclusion of the external.
fix.replace: The external object is established from negative concomitance (vyatireka).

errors.english: those cognitions that appear as objects are not distinct from the objects
errors.why: The verse says the appearing object and the cognition (two items) are not distinct even if an external object exists, not that cognitions are not distinct from objects.
This is a line of the root verse (Pramāṇavārttika) cited before its commentary, turned here into a section heading.

note: Generally follows the svasaṃvedana argument, but the key root line on establishing the external object is misconstrued and verse lines are flattened into prose and a heading.

errors.why: bcom ldan 'das ma is the Bhagavatī, i.e. the Prajñāpāramitā scripture cited as source, not the Buddha speaking.

fix.replace: It is also said in the Bhagavatī [Prajñāpāramitā]:

errors.english: however, this is not a birth within the stainless sphere (anasrava-dhatu)
errors.why: The Tibetan says birth in the three realms ceases but birth in the uncontaminated sphere does not, i.e. that birth continues.

fix.find: however, this is not a birth within the stainless sphere (anasrava-dhatu)
fix.replace: but birth within the stainless sphere (anasrava-dhatu) is not reversed

errors.why: yang srid pa is rebirth/re-existence (punarbhava), not mere existence.

note: Readable account of the mind-made body, but the Bhagavatī citation is turned into the Buddha speaking and the point about birth in the uncontaminated sphere is inverted.

errors.english: Whether human or (kinnara) half-human celestial musicians, the world
errors.why: mi 'am ci is one word, kiṃnara; there is no 'human or' — it is the world together with its kinnaras.

fix.find: Whether human or (kinnara) half-human celestial musicians, the world
fix.replace: The world together with its (kinnara) half-human celestial musicians

errors.english: toward this world that possesses your knowledge and love
errors.why: 'Possessing knowledge and love' is a vocative to the Buddha, not a description of the world.

fix.find: toward this world that possesses your knowledge and love
fix.replace: toward this very world, you who possess knowledge and love

errors.english: Hero, because we are separated from you, we wander aimlessly
errors.why: པོ completes mgon po ('Protector') from the previous side, and the subject who wanders is 'this world blinded by ignorance', not 'we'.

errors.english: Who else shall receive the supreme dust of your feet upon their heads
errors.why: The verse laments that he whose foot-dust the gods placed on their heads has himself perished; it does not ask who will receive the dust.

note: Lament verses rendered as fluent prose with the overall sense kept, but several referents are confused and kinnara is mistranslated.

errors.why: The commentary is glossing a phrase of the rule (atyayika-cīvara, emergency robes), not a text title.

errors.english: if it is worn during the summer or if one keeps it after the time for wearing such robes has passed
errors.why: bgo/bgos here most likely means distributing the robes (inside the rains; the robe-distribution period), not wearing them.

note: Follows the Vinaya rules on emergency robes and the forest-dweller's robe deposit, but presents the glossed phrase as a text title and probably misreads robe distribution as wearing.
Accurate rendering of the argument against universals benefiting particulars, with sound notes.

errors.english: What is explained in the commentary
errors.why: rnam 'grel is the title Pramāṇavārttika, not a generic commentary.

fix.find: What is explained in the commentary
fix.replace: What is explained in the Pramāṇavārttika

note: Sound handling of the pakṣa/pakṣābhāsa discussion, with some clumsy phrasing; one title rendered as a generic noun.
Faithful rendering of the pregnant doe episode; verse is given as prose but nothing is lost.

errors.english: To be composed [note: conditioned or constructed] by hair and such things is also without purpose.
errors.why: 'dus byas here means grooming or adorning the hair and so on (which the next two verses show is pointless), not 'conditioned'.

note: Good rendering of the meditation on the body's impurity; one closing transition is misread and wrongly glossed.

errors.english: (Arya Manjushri-vikurvana Sutra) The Noble Sutra of the Manifestations of Manjushri
errors.why: rnam par rol pa is vikrīḍita ('play'); the sūtra is the Mañjuśrīvikrīḍita.

note: Accurate rendering of the Ratnakūṭa, Sarvāstivāda and Upāli citations; only one sūtra title is misidentified.
